era: 2019 Kickstarter: white header with the green kickstarter wordmark, Explore and Start a project on the left, search and Log in / Sign up on the right; section nav (Arts, Comics & Illustration, Design & Tech, Film, Food & Craft, Games, Music, Publishing) and on discover the 15 categories; project cards with Projects We Love badges and save; footer About / Support / More from Kickstarter columns, language and currency selectors, social icons and legal links. Post-2019 Status, Forward Funds, Brand assets, Kickstarter Project Updates and the app-store badges are hidden.

discover page markup: category menu Art, Comics, Crafts, Dance, Design, Fashion, Film & Video, Food, Games, Journalism, Music, Photography, Publishing, Technology, Theater with subcategories; sorts Magic, Popularity, Newest, End Date, Most Funded; filters Projects We Love, Saved projects; Explore N projects, Load more
